categories.question: You and your date are packing for a sunset picnic. What is the first thing you put in the basket?

outcomes.name: A flask of berry tea
outcomes.description: Tall thermos and a little cup filled with steaming red berry tea

outcomes.name: A jar of lemon posset
outcomes.description: Small lidded jam jar of pale lemon dessert topped with a curl of lemon peel

outcomes.name: A loaf of rosemary bread
outcomes.description: Rustic small round loaf of golden bread crowned with rosemary

outcomes.name: A paper bag of cherries
outcomes.description: Open brown paper bag overflowing with paired dark-red cherries and green stems
